sample_unit: patients meeting SEP-1 criteria (treated by 66 attending physicians)

links.outcome: Effect of LLM-based SEP-1 feedback on compliance, 30-day mortality, and ICU admission in a randomized trial
links.effect: SEP-1 compliance 82.9% vs 70.1% (absolute +13.0%, OR 2.10, 95% CI 1.15-3.81, P=.02); no significant differences in ICU admissions or 30-day mortality.
links.quote: No significant differences existed in intensive care unit admissions or 30-day mortality.

unlisted_practices: LLM-based near-real-time medical record abstraction with targeted physician feedback at discharge to improve quality measure (SEP-1) compliance

screen.reason: The study is a cluster randomized trial evaluating the impact of near-real-time LLM-driven feedback to emergency department physicians regarding SEP-1 bundle compliance during real-world clinical care.

primary.practice: near-real-time clinician feedback on quality metrics
